#23012
INTRO DATE
Marecér 18\202b

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
be amended by changing all the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 1-1 in the area bounded by

the alley next north of and parallel to West Madison Street;
North Sacramento Boulevard; West Madison Street; and a line 139.82 feet
west of and parallel to North Sacramento Boulevard

to those of a C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 3000 West Madison Street
